status_detail: Montana DEQ final/effective MAQP #5256-01 transferred the existing Rowin 17-5 CTB Site permit from Crusoe Energy Systems to NYDIG DFM; DEQ analysis says engines generate electricity for small data centers at an existing site in Richland County about 19.4 miles north of Sidney.
notes: Capacity is approximate mechanical output from permitted 12,970 bhp total engine rating (10,000 bhp Waukesha plus 2,970 bhp Doosan) converted at 0.0007457 MW/bhp; actual IT load not stated.

status_detail: Montana DEQ MAQP #5316-02 analysis locates the Meldahl Facility about 2.8 miles southeast of Snowden in Richland County; permit history says Crusoe received the original permit for up to six 2,500 bhp engines to power local data farms, then ownership transferred to NYDIG DFM.
notes: Capacity is approximate mechanical output from six 2,500 bhp engines (15,000 bhp) converted at 0.0007457 MW/bhp; actual IT load not stated.

project_name: NYDIG DFM proposed well-pad data center near Sidney
status_detail: Local news reported a DEQ public comment period through June 15, 2026 for NYDIG DFM's proposed Richland County data center using eight 2,500 bhp engines consuming well-pad field gas; report said DEQ indicated plans to award the permit.
notes: Could be a new NYDIG site or an amendment not matched to an official permit URL during rapid pass. Capacity is approximate from 20,000 bhp engine rating; article describes the load as nearly 15 MW.

aliases: Atlas Power Group Butte data center
status_detail: NorthWestern Energy announced electric supply service to Atlas Power Group's Butte data center: 75 MW beginning in 2026 with forecast growth up to another 75 MW over the following three to five years. Local reporting describes an existing air-cooled cryptocurrency-mining/data-center facility south of Butte.
notes: Use 75 MW as contracted 2026 supply/load from NorthWestern. Expansion potential adds another 75 MW; Montana Free Press frames the proposal as a 150 MW expansion of an existing facility.

status_detail: Butte-Silver Bow's data-center information site says the county entered a PSA in April 2025 with Sabey/Horizon's Montana for 606.5 acres in Montana Connections TEDD and described an initial 50 MW campus scaling to 200 MW. May 2026 industry news reported Sabey backed out after REC Silicon bought the site, though Sabey was still looking in southwest Montana including Silver Bow.
notes: Status mapped to rejected because schema lacks canceled/withdrawn; project appears withdrawn/canceled for the Montana Connections parcel, not formally rejected by county. Capacity field uses initial 50 MW; source also reports scale-up to 200 MW/250 MW depending source and timing.
